stem.text: A U-shaped glass tube contains liquid of density $2000\,\text{kg m}^{-3}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a U-shaped glass tube containing liquid, shaded grey. The tube is labelled tube and the liquid is labelled liquid, density 2000 kg m^-3. Levels P and Q are marked in the left and right limbs, with dashed lines across the tube. A vertical arrow labelled 10.0 cm spans from level P down to the bottom of the tube, and a vertical arrow labelled 6.0 cm spans from level Q down to the bottom of the tube.

stem.text: What is the difference in pressure due to the liquid between levels P and Q?
